work.description: Entire CDXI Ferdinand rosary indulgence grant and context read, including exact issuer LF91511, own address/salutation, enumerated substantive conditions, blessing and dating LF91647–91650. Own dates and marginal synopsis are separate LF blocks; body page continuation remains coherent and complete. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
